Flavored Steamed Cabbage
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 16, 2009 - 11:25pm

Ingredients




cabbage
1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
1/4 cup honey

Preparation

1 I always add honey and balsamic vinegar to my steamed cabbage (along with some red onions). Proportions? I don't measure them, but probably a quarter cup of vinegar and a quarter cup of honey to a head of cabbage. 2 It's really good, probably would be even better with celery and carrots. 3 NOTES : Another good way is to use chicken broth as the liquid when cooking cabbage,etc.-and sometimes I also add a tiny bit of
